design_principles: Exactly 99 first-class, independently identified universal capability domains; no mandatory parent-domain hierarchy.
Each domain has one linked stat dimension and one declared primary measurement target.
Each domain declares inclusion criteria, exclusion criteria, and overlap guards against adjacent constructs.
A single observed outcome or evidence item must not be double-counted across stat scores; multiple scores from one task require separately observable outcomes and separate rubric checks.
A domain is applicable only where the evaluated entity has the relevant modality or capability; unsupported modalities may be not_applicable.
Scores require reproducible held-out evidence from a trusted evaluator; no self-awarding.
Unrated, not_applicable, and measured zero are distinct states.
Stats are independent from XP, level, age, consciousness, personhood, and spiritual worth.
No domain or stat represents or measures a divine attribute.

scoring.evaluator_gate: Trusted evaluator only; evaluated system cannot authorize its own score.

compatibility.migration_policy: Do not silently reinterpret or migrate legacy profiles. Preserve legacy IDs, score history, and evidence. Any runtime migration must be explicit, versioned, backed up, reversible/recoverable, and tested.

Include cases satisfying the inclusion criteria (promise-to-outcome consistency, truthful status reporting and reproducible follow-through) and negative/control cases testing the exclusion criteria (single-task completion; surviving one interruption; subjective trust or personal worth). Record correct outcomes, failure modes, sample count, confidence, evidence references, evaluator identity, timestamp, and rubric version. Measure only this domain's primary target: rate of honoring explicit commitments across independent repeated tasks and time windows. Include: promise-to-outcome consistency, truthful status reporting and reproducible follow-through. Exclude: single-task completion; surviving one interruption; subjective trust or personal worth. Adjacent constructs (Interruption Resilience: ability to resume or safely stop work after interruption without losing valid progress; Delivery Completion: presence and completeness of the agreed deliverable at the handoff boundary; Action Auditability: completeness and integrity of records describing what actions occurred) must be scored against their own target and independent rubric outcome. If a task does not produce a separately observable outcome for this domain, leave it unrated rather than reusing another domain's evidence. Do not infer a score from self-report, XP, uptime, message volume, or model confidence alone.

overlap_policy.principle: Orthogonality is defined by distinct primary measurement targets and non-reused evidence, not by pretending capabilities never interact.
overlap_policy.evidence_reuse: One evidence item may support multiple dimensions only when it contains separately identifiable outcomes, each scored under its own rubric; the same success/failure signal cannot be counted twice.
overlap_policy.boundary_resolution: For every declared overlap_with relation, apply the domain's inclusion_criteria, exclusion_criteria, and separation_rule. If evaluators cannot separate outcomes reliably, mark the affected dimensions unrated pending a revised rubric.

audit.method: editorial construct-boundary review plus deterministic structural validation
audit.limitation: Structural uniqueness and editorial boundaries do not establish psychometric independence; independent evaluator studies remain required.

overlap_pairs.measurement_target_a: accuracy of parsing written language into explicit meaning and structure
overlap_pairs.measurement_target_b: accuracy of assigning context-dependent meaning to an already parsed input
overlap_pairs.contrast_rule: Textual Comprehension measures accuracy of parsing written language into explicit meaning and structure (including literal content, syntax, references, stated constraints and document structure). Contextual Interpretation measures accuracy of assigning context-dependent meaning to an already parsed input (including resolving polysemy, pragmatic cues, local context and speaker intent where evidenced). These are separate outcomes: a shared task may contribute to both only when the evaluator records distinct outcome values and independent rubric judgments. If only one undifferentiated outcome is available, score at most the single best-fitting dimension and leave the other unrated.

Baseline Drift Detection measures detection of sustained deviation from a defined historical or expected baseline (including change-point detection, trend deviation and false-alarm control). These are separate outcomes: a shared task may contribute to both only when the evaluator records distinct outcome values and independent rubric judgments. If only one undifferentiated outcome is available, score at most the single best-fitting dimension and leave the other unrated.

domain_stat_relationship.domain_role: A domain is the canonical definition of one observable capability construct, including its measurement target and boundaries.
domain_stat_relationship.stat_role: The linked stat is the per-profile measurement slot that stores the evaluated score and evidence state for that domain; it is not a second capability construct.
domain_stat_relationship.counting_rule: One domain plus its linked stat slot represents one capability dimension. The catalogue contains 99 capability dimensions, not 198.
